explanation: Erdős [Er84d] proved H_k(n) ≪ n^{2/3} with an absolute constant. The statement restricts to k ≥ 4, and the docstring correctly explains why the ordered-pair convention forces this (k ≤ 3 makes the bound false or degenerate). It asserts an absolute C with H_k(n) ≤ Cn^{2/3} eventually for each k ≥ 4. A careful, faithful formalisation.
